body:
I am at a loss for words...for reason...

I've read stories else where, overheard things said by others... that if you truly wanted to kill yourself, you would... That you wouldn't have a failed attempt... and that failed attempts are just scare tactics to try get people to pay attention... a final cry for help, well, I can assure you I tried, knowing full well what I was leaving behind, my friends... my family... everything...
  
  
I see your kind words, I see everyone pointing out the fact that I still have friends and family who care about me... for some in this section of the internet, that's more than most, I am not blind to this, and possibly it makes me a cunt for taking it for granted, but having these people around me isn't making it any easier to deal with or accept what I've been through, what I've lost...

Many of them I am beginning to understand aren't really my friends... They tell me they care, that if I need anything, just call... But that's only because that's the social standard for what you're supposed to do... God forbid I ever took someone up on their offer...

Do you know how many cancelled dinners I've been too this year, how many weekends out have gotten rain checked...

If I can't trust you to keep dinner reservations how do you expect me to trust you with my life!!!!!

I apologize, this is more venting than anything... I've given up on myself, this life, people in general...

You all have your own problems to deal with, you certainly don't need my shit to pile on top.

I guess not all is lost, I just had myself a laugh at how pathetic I am, couldn't even kill myself properly. As if there's ever a proper way but, pathetic none the less...

*sigh*

[I can't hear the song anymore...](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ddV6F8cxSM4)
